Usage: drive respond <view> <action> [flags]

Answer the prompt a session waits on.

A deny ends the turn, and the session takes its next step as usual. On a
question, approve takes the option ❯ points at and deny dismisses it, after
which a send can answer in words; read --screen shows the options. It prints
what the session reads afterwards.

Arguments:
  <view>               The view the answer was decided on.
  <action>             approve or deny the prompt, interrupt the turn, or clear a line left in its
                       input box (one of: approve, deny, interrupt, clear).

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME     Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's current
                       one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME    Act in the batch this driver drives now; a chat driver's name is its
                       webhook's. It may stand anywhere on the line.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner
